initial_result: Global staged diff whitespace check failed before commit; its unbounded diagnostics were truncated.
observed_cause: Verbatim Windows evidence retained with CRLF under -text attributes is reported as trailing whitespace by the default check. Evidence diffs and logs are immutable byte artifacts, not newly authored runtime source.
resolution: Preserve evidence bytes and validate staged object identity; run a captured, scoped whitespace check on the newly authored documentation and publisher. The full whitespace check is not relabeled PASS.
